method: Exact text comparison after lexically removing only line comments whose content starts @[ (CIRCT source locations). Strings, code, widths, names, ordering, whitespace, block comments/synthesis directives, and all other comments retained. Full raw and normalized SHA256 per file. No signal renaming or logic normalization.

logical_difference_explanation.interpretation: Requested clock increase adjusts the existing debounce count proportionally (100 us at nominal 100/110 MHz); not a PE pipeline-depth change. Reset final-stage replication is applied later, after placement.

limitations: Pre-synthesis generated RTL comparison. Does not establish routed reset replication equivalence or actual achieved PLL clock; those require implementation reports.
